sprint: BACKLOG.md Feature 1 Phase 2 — Studio's PictureStudio (js/pictureStudio.js) is now Image Studio: on every picture upload the standalone tool's ES module Web Worker (tools/background-remover/js/worker.js — the identical detectBackground → runStrategy → featherMask → applyAlpha → cropPixelBuffer pipeline Phase 1 already shipped) is spawned in-process via new Worker(url,{type:'module'}), invoked against whatever the user has already flipped/rotated (baked into the pixel buffer via _bakeSourceForBg so 'remove the background of what I'm looking at' reads right), and the returned buffer becomes a new source image the existing rotate/flip/crop/enhance stack draws from unchanged; Undo BG reverts to the pristine original. Header title rebranded from '📸 Picture Studio' to '🖼️ Image Studio' with matching subtitle. Public open() API is untouched — every one of the 7 existing PictureStudio.open() call sites across js/app.js, js/contextPanel.js (7 sites), and js/pageDesigner.js works with zero change.

Added .picture-studio-tool-status CSS rule. No API change, no schema change, no compile pipeline touched — every existing call site works unchanged.
